title: On global Lyapunov functions being Morse
summary: Lyapunov functions have been a cornerstone of dynamical systems theory ever since the early 1900s. Moreover and akin to Morse theory, Lyapunov functions have been the key in linking topology to dynamical systems theory. In this note we continue along these lines. Suppose that some vector field on Euclidean space has a unique equilibrium point that is globally asymptotically stable (GAS). Under these conditions, it is known that there is always a smooth Lyapunov function to certify stability. One may wonder if this function can always be chosen to be Morse.
